newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines says has not abandoned Yankee bond.
newsitem.headline: Philippines says has not abandoned Yankee bond.

text.p: Philippine Central Bank governor Gabriel Singson said on Thursday the bank has not given up its intention to issue the country's first sovereign Yankee bond.
"We have not abandoned the idea. We will reset it to a better time," Singson told reporters after arriving from New York where he aborted the bond issue lastweek, hours before its planned launch.
The Central Bank said the issue, which was to consist of a 30-year and 100-year tranche, was delayed by adverse market conditions in the U.S.
He added he was prepared to face any congressional inquiry regarding the $750-million planned flotation.

There has been some local opposition to the bond on the grounds that it would add to the country's debt burden. The government argues the issue will help establish a benchmark for other Philippine borrowers.
